## Problem and result

Describe the concrete trigger and resulting behavior.

## Verification

Commands/results, relevant negative cases, and any untested provider behavior.

## Compatibility

Document CLI/state/permission changes, dependency licenses, migration or rollback
needs, and user documentation updates. Write “none” if not applicable.

## Review and handoff

Independent reviewer and reviewed commit: pending until recorded.
Findings/resolution, remaining QA and any dependent PRs:
Task worktree/branch: retain while this PR or QA is open.

Before merge: focused diff, independent review of the final change, required CI,
applicable QA and maintainer authorization. Publication is a separate decision.
